description.value:
From Echoes · Stick written sounds onto things, and they become real.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: place a mark on a surface or creature within 30 ft (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates on a creature). Pick one: BOOM (@Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level-1)/4))d6[sonic]] when touched or at your next turn), SLIP (difficult terrain, Acrobatics DC or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}), BOING (creature entering is pushed 10 ft).
  • 5: Keep two marks; add SIZZLE (fire instead of sonic, @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]]).
  • 9: A creature with a mark is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{deafened} while it lasts.
  • 13: Surge, HEAVY: target with a mark (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude}) is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} and can't fly; critical failure also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round.
  • 17: Surge, FREEZE: one creature or moving object within 30 ft stops dead; @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{paralyzed} for 1 round on a failure (incapacitation).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
